description: A further member to reach the ungraded state: roadmap-claims, which feature 021 teaches to say UNGRADED when the tip date or the Owner of a claim cannot be read. RIT-006 and RIT-007 prove the aggregator lifts the word for enforcement-pack and scope-check. This one is a regression guard on the union of $naCapableMembers and $ungradedCapableMembers, which already lifted this member before feature 021 (phase 3 review F2: the plan's D8 premise was wrong), so it fails only if the name leaves both lists. Exit 0 in both directions: UNGRADED is a verdict, never an exit code. Differs from the pass direction in exactly one line of one stub (plan D10).

write.scripts/roadmap-claim-check.ps1:
param([string]$Root, [string]$Branch, [switch]$All, [switch]$Check)
Write-Host 'roadmap-claims: UNGRADED (2 claim(s) visible with non-idea rows; the claim count for ada was not made - the reason is on the line(s) above)'
exit 0
